about.title: About
about.body: Senior software engineer with 15+ years of experience across telecommunications, banking, insurance, transport and pharmaceutical supply. I specialize in enterprise software modernization, cloud architecture, DevOps/DevSecOps pipelines, microservices and technical leadership — taking complex systems from architecture to production.

items.title: Enterprise Identity Platform
items.challenge: Modernize authentication across a suite of pharmaceutical applications post-COVID, enabling secure remote access for hundreds of users.
items.solution: Implemented IdentityServer with 2-Factor Authentication (QR code/SMS), unified authentication across all applications, and migrated infrastructure to Microsoft Azure.
items.impact: Secured remote access for the entire organization, reduced authentication-related support tickets, and established a foundation for cloud migration.
items.technologies: programming languages, IdentityServer, Azure, JavaScript, 2FA, DevOps

items.title: Cloud Data Architecture for Asset Management
items.challenge: Integrate multiple financial data sources for retirement fund liquidation, requiring real-time data mapping and cloud-native architecture.
items.solution: Designed microservices architecture with Azure Service Bus, integrated Belfius data flows from Brussels, built batch processing with SSIS, and implemented WCF/Web API services.
items.impact: Unified data from multiple sources into a single platform, enabling automated fund processing and reducing manual reconciliation.
items.technologies: programming languages, Oracle, SSIS, WCF, Web API, Azure, DevOps

items.title: High-Performance Trading Systems
items.challenge: Build and maintain high-performance trading applications for dark pool and crossing network systems in a multithreaded environment.
items.solution: Developed multithreaded programming languages applications, implemented FIX protocol integration, built market data connectors with socket-layer parsing, and migrated trading automata.
items.impact: Maintained mission-critical trading infrastructure processing real-time market data, ensuring system reliability in a zero-downtime environment.
items.technologies: programming languages, C++, FIX Protocol, SignalR, Ultra Messaging, SVN/CVS

items.title: Contact Center Microservices
items.challenge: Modernize a 10-year-old call-center platform, introducing service-oriented architecture and integrating multiple financial payment providers.
items.solution: Designed microservices architecture with Docker containers, implemented Protocol Buffers for efficient serialization, introduced Kafka for event-driven messaging, and automated deployment pipelines.
items.impact: Transformed a monolithic application into a scalable microservices platform, enabling independent service deployment and horizontal scaling.
items.technologies: programming languages, Docker, Kafka, Protocol Buffers, Oracle, PowerShell

items.title: Fleet Management Platform
items.challenge: Develop backend systems for a vehicle fleet management platform, including payment integration and performance monitoring.
items.solution: Built .NET Core backend services, implemented payment system integration with suppliers, developed back-office modules for real-time fleet tracking and performance monitoring.
items.impact: Enabled operational monitoring of fleet vehicles, streamlined payment processing, and provided management with real-time performance dashboards.
items.technologies: programming languages, .NET Core, API Development, Visual Studio
